groups.blurb: A guided path on 6×6 boards: one new shape at a time, easy first, ending with a taste of two shapes.

groups.name: Classical L-panel
groups.blurb: The original puzzle: cut the board into L tetrominoes. Mixed board sizes.

groups.name: One shape
groups.blurb: Every tile is the same shape (not the L): a mix of shapes and board sizes in each book.

groups.name: Two shapes
groups.blurb: Each tile is either of two shapes: a mix of pairs and board sizes in each book.
